gaps.sentence: The museum's ___ (EXHIBIT) of Egyptian art opens on Friday.
gaps.explanation: 'An exhibition' = a public display of art; 'an exhibit' is a single item.

gaps.sentence: The factory has doubled its ___ (PRODUCE) of electric batteries.
gaps.explanation: 'Its production' — the noun for the amount manufactured follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: She spoke with great ___ (WISE) about the risks.

gaps.explanation: 'Championship victory' — the title/contest, not the person.

gaps.sentence: The document is of great ___ (IMPORTANT) to the case.
___ (APPOINT) with the results, the board replaced the management.
gaps.hint: participle adjective: how the board felt
gaps.explanation: 'Disappointed with the results' — the board experienced disappointment; '-ing' would describe the results.
'Trustworthy' = deserving trust; 'trusted' also works but 'trustworthy' is the quality.
